name: Floridia (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Floridia (a flower on blue beneath a chief with an eagle and red and yellow pales) within branches, with the motto XIRIDIA DILECTA on a scroll.
history: Municipal flag of Floridia, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 11 October 1999.

features.role: Floridia arms — flower on blue beneath a chief with an eagle and red and yellow pales, crowned, within branches, with motto XIRIDIA DILECTA
